```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# Requires `deg_table_all` generated in 02_visium_DEG.Rmd.
```

```{r}
### SETUP

output_dir <- "04_regional_transcriptional_similarity"

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)


target_regions <- c(
  "dSTRr",
  "NAS",
  "PIRc",
  "dSTRc",
  "S1c"
)


# Expression filter for the Spearman analysis

minimum_pct <- 0.10
minimum_regions_expressed <- 2L


# DEG definition for the Jaccard analysis

adjusted_p_cutoff <- 0.05
absolute_log2fc_cutoff <- 0.25


# Hierarchical clustering method

clustering_method <- "average"
```

```{r}
### CHECK REQUIRED COLUMNS

required_columns <- c(
  "gene",
  "region",
  "avg_log2FC",
  "pct.1",
  "pct.2",
  "p_val_adj"
)


missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(deg_table_all)
)


if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "deg_table_all is missing the following columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


missing_regions <- setdiff(
  target_regions,
  unique(
    as.character(
      deg_table_all$region
    )
  )
)


if (length(missing_regions) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "The following target regions are absent from deg_table_all: ",
      paste(
        missing_regions,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
### PREPARE ONE ROW PER GENE AND REGION

deg_similarity <- deg_table_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene = trimws(
      as.character(gene)
    ),
    region = as.character(region),
    avg_log2FC = as.numeric(avg_log2FC),
    pct.1 = as.numeric(pct.1),
    pct.2 = as.numeric(pct.2),
    p_val_adj = as.numeric(p_val_adj)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    region %in% target_regions,
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != ""
  ) %>%

  # If duplicate gene-region rows exist, retain the row with
  # the smallest adjusted p-value.

  dplyr::group_by(
    gene,
    region
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    is.na(p_val_adj),
    p_val_adj,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%

  dplyr::mutate(
    maximum_pct = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(pct.1) & is.na(pct.2) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ pmax(
        pct.1,
        pct.2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),
    sufficiently_expressed =
      !is.na(maximum_pct) &
      maximum_pct >= minimum_pct,

    significant_deg =
      !is.na(p_val_adj) &
      p_val_adj < adjusted_p_cutoff &
      abs(avg_log2FC) > absolute_log2fc_cutoff,

    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      significant_deg & avg_log2FC > 0 ~ "up",
      significant_deg & avg_log2FC < 0 ~ "down",
      TRUE                             ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```

```{r}
### SPEARMAN ANALYSIS: SELECT GENES SUITABLE FOR REGIONAL COMPARISON

eligible_genes <- deg_similarity %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_regions_expressed = sum(
      sufficiently_expressed,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_regions_expressed >= minimum_regions_expressed
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)


cat(
  "Genes retained for Spearman analysis:",
  length(eligible_genes),
  "\n"
)


if (length(eligible_genes) < 2) {

  stop(
    "Fewer than two genes passed the expression filter."
  )
}
```

```{r}
### CONSTRUCT GENE-BY-REGION LOG2FC MATRIX

fc_table <- deg_similarity %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    gene %in% eligible_genes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    region,
    avg_log2FC
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = region,
    values_from = avg_log2FC
  )


fc_matrix <- fc_table %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()


fc_matrix <- fc_matrix[
  ,
  target_regions,
  drop = FALSE
]


# Retain genes with finite values in at least two regions

fc_matrix <- fc_matrix[
  rowSums(
    is.finite(fc_matrix)
  ) >= 2,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


utils::write.csv(
  data.frame(
    gene = rownames(fc_matrix),
    fc_matrix,
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_gene_log2FC_matrix.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
### SPEARMAN CORRELATION MATRIX

spearman_matrix <- stats::cor(
  fc_matrix,
  method = "spearman",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)


if (any(!is.finite(spearman_matrix))) {

  stop(
    "The Spearman correlation matrix contains non-finite values."
  )
}


utils::write.csv(
  spearman_matrix,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_log2FC_Spearman_matrix.csv"
  ),
  row.names = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
### INDEPENDENT HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING: SPEARMAN MATRIX

spearman_distance <- stats::as.dist(
  1 - spearman_matrix
)


spearman_hclust <- stats::hclust(
  spearman_distance,
  method = clustering_method
)

```

```{r}
### FIGURE: CLUSTERED SPEARMAN CORRELATION HEATMAP

# Keep the original matrix unchanged for clustering.
# Remove the uninformative diagonal only from the plotted matrix.

spearman_plot_matrix <- spearman_matrix

diag(
  spearman_plot_matrix
) <- NA_real_


# Fixed symmetric scale around zero.
# Observed off-diagonal correlations range approximately
# from 0.14 to 0.35.

spearman_colour_limit <- 0.50


spearman_colours <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c(
    "#2166ac",
    "white",
    "#b2182b"
  )
)(
  100
)


spearman_breaks <- seq(
  -spearman_colour_limit,
  spearman_colour_limit,
  length.out = 101
)


# Create the displayed values separately so that the
# diagonal can remain blank.

spearman_number_matrix <- matrix(
  sprintf(
    "%.2f",
    spearman_matrix
  ),
  nrow = nrow(
    spearman_matrix
  ),
  ncol = ncol(
    spearman_matrix
  ),
  dimnames = dimnames(
    spearman_matrix
  )
)


diag(
  spearman_number_matrix
) <- ""


grDevices::pdf(
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_log2FC_Spearman_clustered_heatmap.pdf"
  ),
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)


pheatmap::pheatmap(
  spearman_plot_matrix,

  cluster_rows = spearman_hclust,
  cluster_cols = spearman_hclust,

  color = spearman_colours,
  breaks = spearman_breaks,

  na_col = "grey90",

  display_numbers = spearman_number_matrix,

  border_color = "white",

  fontsize = 11,
  fontsize_number = 10,

  main = paste0(
    "Regional transcriptional-response similarity\n",
    "Spearman correlation of gene-wise log2FC profiles"
  ),

  legend = TRUE
)


grDevices::dev.off()
```

```{r}
### CONSTRUCT SIGNED DEG SETS FOR JACCARD ANALYSIS

# Each gene-direction combination is treated as a separate element.
# Examples: "Snap25__up" and "Snap25__down"
# A gene therefore contributes to the intersection only when it
# is significantly regulated in the same direction in both regions.

signed_deg_sets <- deg_similarity %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significant_deg,
    !is.na(direction)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    signed_gene = paste(
      gene,
      direction,
      sep = "__"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    signed_genes = list(
      unique(signed_gene)
    ),
    n_signed_degs = dplyr::n_distinct(
      signed_gene
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


missing_jaccard_regions <- setdiff(
  target_regions,
  signed_deg_sets$region
)


if (length(missing_jaccard_regions) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "No significant signed DEGs were found for: ",
      paste(
        missing_jaccard_regions,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


signed_deg_sets <- signed_deg_sets %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    region = factor(
      region,
      levels = target_regions
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(region)


utils::write.csv(
  signed_deg_sets %>%
    dplyr::select(
      region,
      n_signed_degs
    ),
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_signed_DEG_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
### DIRECTION-CONCORDANT JACCARD MATRIX

jaccard_matrix <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(target_regions),
  ncol = length(target_regions),
  dimnames = list(
    target_regions,
    target_regions
  )
)


for (region_1 in target_regions) {

  genes_1 <- signed_deg_sets %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(region) == region_1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(signed_genes)


  genes_1 <- genes_1[[1]]


  for (region_2 in target_regions) {

    genes_2 <- signed_deg_sets %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        as.character(region) == region_2
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(signed_genes)


    genes_2 <- genes_2[[1]]


    union_genes <- union(
      genes_1,
      genes_2
    )


    if (length(union_genes) == 0) {

      jaccard_matrix[
        region_1,
        region_2
      ] <- NA_real_

    } else {

      jaccard_matrix[
        region_1,
        region_2
      ] <- length(
        intersect(
          genes_1,
          genes_2
        )
      ) / length(
        union_genes
      )
    }
  }
}


if (any(!is.finite(jaccard_matrix))) {

  stop(
    "The direction-concordant Jaccard matrix contains non-finite values."
  )
}


utils::write.csv(
  jaccard_matrix,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_direction_concordant_DEG_Jaccard_matrix.csv"
  ),
  row.names = TRUE
)


```

```{r}
### INDEPENDENT HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING: JACCARD MATRIX

jaccard_distance <- stats::as.dist(
  1 - jaccard_matrix
)


jaccard_hclust <- stats::hclust(
  jaccard_distance,
  method = clustering_method
)
```

```{r}
### FIGURE: CLUSTERED DIRECTION-CONCORDANT JACCARD HEATMAP

# Use a separate matrix for plotting so the original matrix,
# including its diagonal, remains unchanged.

jaccard_plot_matrix <- jaccard_matrix


# The diagonal is always 1 and contains no comparative
# information. Display it in grey rather than allowing it to
# determine the color scale.

diag(
  jaccard_plot_matrix
) <- NA_real_


# Determine the largest observed off-diagonal Jaccard value.

jaccard_max <- max(
  jaccard_plot_matrix,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# Round the upper color limit up to the next 0.05.
# For example, a maximum of 0.23 gives a scale from 0 to 0.25.

jaccard_colour_max <- max(
  0.05,
  ceiling(
    jaccard_max / 0.05
  ) * 0.05
)


jaccard_breaks <- seq(
  0,
  jaccard_colour_max,
  length.out = 101
)


jaccard_colours <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c(
    "white",
    "#fcbba1",
    "#67000d"
  )
)(
  100
)


# Use a character matrix so the diagonal can be left blank.

jaccard_number_matrix <- matrix(
  sprintf(
    "%.2f",
    jaccard_matrix
  ),
  nrow = nrow(
    jaccard_matrix
  ),
  ncol = ncol(
    jaccard_matrix
  ),
  dimnames = dimnames(
    jaccard_matrix
  )
)


diag(
  jaccard_number_matrix
) <- ""


grDevices::pdf(
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_direction_concordant_DEG_Jaccard_clustered_heatmap.pdf"
  ),
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)


pheatmap::pheatmap(
  jaccard_plot_matrix,

  cluster_rows = jaccard_hclust,
  cluster_cols = jaccard_hclust,

  color = jaccard_colours,
  breaks = jaccard_breaks,

  na_col = "grey90",

  display_numbers = jaccard_number_matrix,

  border_color = "white",

  fontsize = 11,
  fontsize_number = 10,

  main = paste0(
    "Direction-concordant overlap of significant DEG sets\n",
    "padj < ",
    adjusted_p_cutoff,
    ", |log2FC| > ",
    absolute_log2fc_cutoff
  ),

  legend = TRUE
)


grDevices::dev.off()
```
